mechanical_mounting.closure_requires: Provide populated PCB/component, connector-mate, harness/bend-radius, thermal and service-tool envelopes; pass and sign the tolerance-aware final interference/service-access review; obtain responsible mechanical engineer and fabricator DFM approval; promote Revision B candidate CAD/drawing to a signed released revision.

production_connectors.architecture_decision: EVT uses an external official Raspberry Pi CM5 IO Board revision 2 independently powered at J11 by an approved 5 V/5 A USB-C PD source. J_CM5 is signal-only and maps exactly to CM5IO J8. A custom integrated CM5 carrier is deferred to a later revision.
production_connectors.critical_finding: The unsafe J_CM5 5 V/external 3.3 V paths remain removed. The generator now implements the Molex 90130-1116 2.54 mm footprint/body and manufacturer column numbering; the exact 16-wire mapping to CM5IO J8 is controlled. CM5IO is separately powered at J11, so its 5 A envelope is outside BRMC 5V_SYS. Main-logic, safety, isolation, Rear-I/O, analog, 0-10 V and service loads/protection remain unquantified, and unshrouded CM5IO J8 requires first-article orientation controls.
production_connectors.closure_requires: Eliminate all HOLD/TBD load rows using a real schematic/netlist and measured startup/steady/transient evidence; release harness drawings and maximum lengths; verify CM5IO J8 orientation and J_CM5 footprint against first-article hardware; then verify all production connector/contact/terminal MPNs, mating access and reviewer evidence.
